description: Use one Apps Script time-based trigger to record a synthetic marker, then return a pending-review receipt and remove only this test trigger and its script properties. Permitted services: ScriptApp and PropertiesService only.
acceptance_checks: One time-based trigger fires the synthetic handler.
The handler records only a synthetic script-property marker.
The receipt conforms to worker-receipt.schema.json and remains pending review.
The test trigger and test properties are removed after receipt capture.
stop_conditions: Stop if any unexpected trigger or script property exists.
Stop if Drive, Sheets, network, paid APIs, or secrets are needed.
